answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil swarms by requiring newcomers to complete a computational voyage through verifiable delay functions. Solving these sequential, non-parallelizable puzzles forces an attacker to spend dedicated single-core time and energy per identity, piercing the raven obscurity of proxy pools. Although each proof is compact as a walnut for instant auditing, the mechanism imposes registration latency on honest agents and advantages adversaries with custom ASIC hardware.
